_comment: CritterLifegain (2026-09-08). Guards CR 510.2 ordering: combat lifelink gains are applied AFTER every attacker's damage, so Archangel of Thune's own lifelink trigger cannot pump the OTHER attackers in the same damage step. Board: Thune (3/4 lifelink) + Ajani's Pridemate (2/2) + Soul Warden (1/1), all attack-eligible, opponent at 6. Correct combat: 3+2+1 = 6 = exactly lethal on turn 5. If the gain were applied inside the loop it would still be lethal, so the guard is the LIFE total: 20 + 3 (one lifelink event) = 23 -- an in-loop double-count or a per-point event fan-out would read differently in the log. Hand = Plains only so no cast can add damage; library_filler = Plains.
